messages:
anya: quick design sync on the autoscale controls prototype. dropped Figma: https://figma.com/file/new-autoscale

jess: main ask: reduce clicks to choose common pools. propose a 3-item quick-row at the top of the dropdown (most-used + pinned).

mike: backend can return preferredPools array. small API change, will add analytics events (ui.pool.quickpick.select).

jess: selected pool chip should show a tiny SLO label "Low latency" rather than raw ms. more readable.

omar: accessibility: SLO label needs aria-label and 4.5:1 contrast. avoid color-only cues.

lee: copy debate: change "Burst" to "Burst capacity (time-limited)" and tooltip: "Temporary extra GPUs during spikes; billed at standard rates."

khalid: slider accessibility: provide keyboard stepper fallback. announce via aria-live: "Latency target: Balanced. Cost: Medium." Keep it concise.

anya: clamp behavior: if Min > poolMax show inline validation and SR announcement: "Min adjusted to pool max: 4."

mike: note: some pool caps come from another service; client should cache caps for ~120s. I'll add to the API ticket.

jess: i'll update frames with quick-row, SLO label text, and revised burst copy and post tomorrow.

anya: thanks all :thumbsup: will draft rollout notes and canary flag.
